$Comment: An example caster roster that ships switched off: with Enabled false it arms nothing. Switched on, it arms the Ember Dragon (role Dragon_Fire) with three entries. Each is gated by Scope BOSS, so it fires only while the dragon is a member of the Mmoscaling_Bosses group, as it ships. The first is an AbilityId entry: it casts MMO Skill Tree's fireball every CadenceSeconds, give or take JitterSeconds, after a wind-up, where the dragon's own 'Hurt' flinch stands in for a cast animation its model does not have. The other two are NativeChain entries naming attacks this mod ships: Mmoscaling_Demo_Dodge, a dodge, and Mmoscaling_Demo_Ice_Ball, the Goblin Duke's ice ball with a knockback, whose throw animation was made for a goblin and may not play on the dragon. A NativeChain entry is armed once, at spawn, into the mob's own attacks: each time the mob's AI attacks, it takes the armed chains in turn in place of its usual attack, so a mob that never attacks on its own never fires them. CadenceSeconds does nothing on a NativeChain entry, but the content check wants it at 2 or more; JitterSeconds does nothing there either, and a Windup on one is flagged because it never plays. To switch it on, save a file named demo_boss_caster.json in your server's mods/MmoMobScaling/casters/ folder holding just Enabled set to true; it keeps this file's Role and Abilities, and the README.txt in that folder says more. A content pack can switch it on too: copy this file into the pack at the same path, Server/MmoMobScaling/CasterRosters/Demo_Boss_Caster.json, set Enabled to true, and list Ziggfreed:MmoMobScaling under Dependencies in the pack's manifest.json (without it, this mod's copy loads after yours and keeps the example off). To arm a different mob, copy it under a new file name instead: point Role at one role with Id or at a family with Glob, and tune each entry with CadenceSeconds, JitterSeconds, MinDifficulty, Rarities and Scope.
